sloka: तथेति तत्प्रतिज्ञाय भरद्वाजो महातपा: ।भरतं प्रत्युवाचेदं राघवस्नेहबन्धनात् ॥ २.९०.९
transliteration: tatheti tatpratijñāya bharadvājo mahātapā: ।bharataṁ pratyuvācedaṁ rāghavasnehabandhanāt ॥ 2.90.9

translations.english: Saying, all is well, the great ascetic Bharadwaja, out of his affection for Rama, said to Bharata:
